implementation_summary: Added an end-to-end browser test of the page analysis on fixtures/audit-site: Chromium opens each public fixture page, readPage reads it, accessibilityBasics runs on the Sample Pages / and /gallery, then analyseSite runs with makeOutboundFetch over injected NetDeps limited to the 127.0.0.1 fixture origin, with sign-in, checkout and /private/* passed as skippedPaths. 22 tests map every acceptance criterion of REQ-007/008/009/010/013/014/015/038 and the Skipped Page request-log rule to fixture scenarios. The defect it found (query variants of Skipped Pages requested by checkLinks) was fixed in BE-305; all 22 pass.
